# tests

Test suite for local-router behavior, providers, routing, and API compliance.

## Purpose

- Verify fallback chain execution, disabled models, gateway responses, responses API streams, websocket behavior, provider keys, catalog validation.

## Ownership

- Maintained by local-router team.
- Tests must reflect production behavior in `src/`.

## Local Contracts

- Keep test files MJS.
- Import from `../build/index.js` to test compiled output.

## Work Guidance

- Add tests before changing routing behavior.
- Keep tests deterministic; avoid time-based flakiness.

## Verification

- Run `npm test` or `node --test`.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
